title: Cisseus of Macedon
summary: Raleigh names Cisseus of Macedon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Cisseus, whom Caranus ouerthrew when he became Lord of the rest of Macedon. He is not Cisseus, King of Thrace, father of Hecuba. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
